decision: The merge-time closeout gate triggers on the PR's structured closing references and runs as the last step of the pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge cascade, immediately before the gh pr merge call.

governingRule.description: #3781 fail-closed prevention; #3156 gate integrity; #3265 thin fail-closed design

alternativesConsidered.option: Key the gate on the branch diff (add --base-ref to verify:orphan-active) and run it inside task check
Run the gate early in the cascade, before the wait loop, as the #701 protected-issue check does

whyWinner: A diff trigger cannot fire on the culprit: CI runs before the merge and the issue closes on it, so at check time no orphan exists -- PR 3786's own merge gate returned success while creating one -- and for #3598 the brief landed on master 17h before its closing PR, so it was never in the diff. Running last binds the verdict to the tree that actually merges; the standalone task verify:pr-closeout-attestable verb covers the early-warning case without a second, drift-prone call site.
revisitTrigger: If post-merge automation (#3791) closes the lifecycle window to seconds, or if recorded_by is hardened into an authenticated human gate -- fail-closed would then become a #3779-shaped trap for agent and drive-by authors.
